profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Acuity Brands Lighting | Building Innovative & Secure Software Solutions
profile.summary:
I’m a cybersecurity and software engineering expert with over fifteen years of professional experience and a wide range of computing expertise. My passion is empowering companies to improve their business through innovative software solutions and security practices. 

I’ve built two major software security programs, first at Microsoft and then at Coalition Inc. My unique approach to security combines developer-focused training with automated tooling. In my experience, I’ve found it’s critical to reduce security problems in code by training people, and also provide a safety net for human error with tooling. I’ve had significant success with my approach, and developers in both programs showed marked improvement in security awareness. 

I’m certified as a penetration tester by Offensive Security (OSCP). In addition, I hold a patent for one of Microsoft’s fundamental machine learning and data analysis systems. I’ve worked with Fortune 500 customers in multiple industries including banking, automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare. I also hold a B.S. in Networks and System Administration from the Rochester Institute of Technology.

I bring my diverse skill set and passion for security to every challenge. My holistic and unified approach to secure system design is supported by my extensive experience in security and software engineering. I take pride in using my technical proficiency to implement revolutionary secure services. Most importantly, I value helping customers understand how to better identify and defend against digital threats to their businesses.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C# · Blazor · Internet of Things (IoT)

positions.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
positions.locationName: Rochester, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Designed an application security program from the ground up for an engineering organization of several hundred. This program extended across the entire software stack at Coalition
- Created an AI security program to meet the evolving needs of the industry, bringing a whole new set of tooling and integrations, as well as authoring developer-focused, technical training around AI security risks and potential attack vectors
- Educated engineers on good security and development practices via interactive training
- Worked with vendors to identify, test, and implement products to improve awareness of security problems
- Designed and implemented custom tooling to surface actionable tasks to remediate security issues, and to track the performance and efficacy of the resulting work
positions.insights: Skills: Information Security · Security · Software Engineering · OSCP · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Sr. Software Security Engineer
positions.description:
- Senior subject matter expert in the security technology domain for Microsoft Commercial Software Engineering, which provides defense-in-depth security reviews for Microsoft partners and customers.
- Designed and developed a system to simplify the integration of security development practices into every customer engagement, and to educate SDEs on industry best practices.
- Created and provided design advice for hundred of new cloud application systems for Microsoft's largest and most influential partners.
- Used software development talents to innovate foundational elements of Microsoft's ROS IoT investment, and design a software-powered, highly scalable pop-up event network to save millions of dollars when running employee events.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed scalable key management system for cloud-oriented, role-based, partial protection/encryption of files in C# .NET
- Integrated partial-protection extensions into applications such as Microsoft Word and Excel
- Developed a standalone reader with redaction support for the PDF format
- Designed and implemented database and server architecture for a WCF-based service
- Created extensive service-specific API documentation for a key management system to benefit and accelerate implementation by third party developers

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed scalable analytics system for data forecasting and modeling product, based on the Windows Azure platform, including distributing the processing of R-based algorithms.
- Developed C# abstraction and protocol implementation of Bluetooth-based sensor network for bridge pilings, allowing for concurrent readings in real time across a sensor network.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a system to train medical image processing algorithms for an FDA-regulated immunohematology product, including designing and leveraging software to manage a distributed network of computers to process training operations.
- Developed machine vision camera integration libraries and Cisco custom networks for medical diagnostic products.

positions.title: GxP Computing Rochester Technology Lead
positions.description:
- Developed, trained, and tested process for IQ/OQ of new laboratory and manufacturing production computers. Also managed upgrade of over 6,000 FDA-qualified production systems, including appropriate compliance forms. 
- Maintained and executed qualification and change control documentation, along with associated risk-assessment forms, for FDA-qualified production and laboratory support systems.

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and ran advanced iSeries queries against Brooks/Eckerd/Rite-Aid purchasing and inventory supply databases to generate sales reports. 
- Developed Visual Basic applications to automate most reporting systems.

projects.title: Azure Security
projects.description: Spoke for a double-session at DECODED Conference in Dublin, Ireland. Was among highest-rated talks for the conference.

projects.title: Apache Cordova & VS Tools for Cordova
projects.description: Spoke at Muzik Hackathon in Vancouver, B.C.

patents.title: Modular Electronic Data Analysis Computing System
patents.description: A server device configured to execute an electronic data analysis platform program to store a plurality of modular data processing tools, each modular data processing tool configured to perform data processing with predetermined data types and to combine with other modular data processing tools in a data analysis pipeline, receive a user input of one or more user data sources, map the data of the one or more user data sources to one or more of the predetermined data types, determine a data analytic goal for the mapped one or more user data sources, select one or more modular data processing tools configured to process the one or more predetermined data types mapped to data of the mapped one or more user data sources to generate the data analytic goal, and generate a data analysis pipeline configured to generate the data analytic goal.

patents.title: System And Method For Pattern Recognition And User Interaction
patents.description:
A computer based system for pattern recognition and user interaction that assists users with extracting value from their data. The system for pattern recognition and user
interaction converts free form text queries into usable mathematical models and software
code and provides hierarchical tracing of the free form text queries and related answers while
also providing suggestions for future queries to the user.

organizations.name: OWASP Foundation
organizations.description: Member of the OWASP Foundation, a non-profit organization supporting and promoting good security practice, as well as unifying security professionals from around the world.
